text:
Ava (Marketing): Heads-up — draft for the Optimize launch post is live in the doc: https://docs.google.com/example. Focus: short benchmark note, tiny embeddings example for devs, CTAs + inbound routing. Need legal + sales signoff by Tue EOD to hit Wed publish.

Diego (Content): Pasting a tiny, copy/paste-ready embedding example to include in the post so engineers can try quickly:
```bash
# embeddings (curl)
curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.ai/v1/embeddings \\n  -H 'Authorization: Bearer $REDWOOD_KEY' \\n  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \\n  -d '{"model":"open-embed-lite","input":"Benefits of Redwood Optimize"}'
```

Diego (Content): Example response snippet to show shape: ```json
{"embedding":[0.01,-0.02,0.05,...],"model":"open-embed-lite"}```

Priya (Growth): CTA mapping suggestion:
- Request a demo -> HubSpot form hb-305 (AE: enterprise)
- Try Hosted API -> /signup?utm_source=blog&utm_campaign=optimize_launch&utm_medium=blog (growth SDR)
- Webinar -> Eventbrite -> HubSpot list "Optimize Webinar" (tag: webinar_reg)
Also suggest adding utm_medium=blog to webinar links so we can attribute properly.

Sam (Sales): Agree on CTAs. For webinar -> Ops note: if registrant.company_size > 100 OR role in ["Eng","Product","ML"], mark as MQL and create AE task. Will sync HubSpot field IDs with Ops after my check.

Nina (Legal): Quick legal pass: please remove any hard numeric claims like "5x cheaper" unless we can cite a benchmark. Replace with conservative phrasing: "reduces per-token cost through batching and caching". Also reword SLA language to "where contracted". I can approve once changes are in the doc.

Ava (Marketing): Done — swapped numeric language and added "where contracted" to SLA sentence. I also adjusted the figure caption to: "Latency and per-token cost measured on supported model variants; results vary by workload."

Diego (Content): I inlined the curl example and the response snippet into the draft, tightened the intro paragraph, and trimmed the benchmark blurb per Nina. Left a comment on the CTA anchor text.

OpsBot: Reminder: publish job queued for 2024-08-21T09:00Z. Final copy lock: 2024-08-20T16:00Z. If edits after lock, ping @ops.

Ava (Marketing): Please drop a quick :thumbsup: when you approve the CMS copy and CTA mapping so I can push to CMS.

Nina (Legal): :thumbsup: approved (CMS copy must match doc).

Sam (Sales): :thumbsup: approved. I'll DM full HubSpot mapping to Ops.

Priya (Growth): :thumbsup: from growth. I'll monitor attribution and update UTM sheet.

Ava (Marketing): Thanks team  scheduling the CMS push and closing this thread.
